observed: The first graph fixture harness sent symbol where the ordinary code query API requires name; RPC rejected the request.
cause: Test harness used the wrong request field.
resolution: Corrected the harness to name before reproducing the graph defect; the failing attempt was retained.
proposed_change: For new API integration tests, use the existing request type rather than reproducing its field names.

observed: The requested get-tweet fetch stopped at fxtwitter robots.txt. get-tweet instructed ignoreRobots:true while the mandatory research policy prohibited robots bypass. The user subsequently supplied a locally saved article.
cause: Contradictory shared skill instructions made the documented fetch workflow unable to complete under the mandatory policy.
resolution: Exact article was read from the user-provided local file; the shared instruction conflict remains unresolved.
proposed_change: Make get-tweet state the governing policy and documented permitted retrieval path; resolving any policy exception requires a separate explicit decision.

observed: The graph builder agent authored the implementation, tests and completion audit; no fresh independent verifier had examined the delivered change when completion was declared.
cause: The selected run did not include a separately authorized final verifier.
resolution: User approved one fresh-verifier pilot; independent review is now running.
proposed_change: For substantial runs, authorize a fresh final verifier against the original acceptance criteria and exact delivered revision; retain any disagreements.
